an9.2:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an9.2:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti.
an9.2:1.4: saddhañce bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti.
an9.2:1.8: paññañce bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissāya akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti pahīnamevassa taṃ akusalaṃ hoti.
an9.2:1.9: taṃ hi’ssa bhikkhuno akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti suppahīnaṃ, yaṃsa ariyāya paññāya disvā pahīnaṃ.
an9.2:2.1: tena ca pana bhikkhu, bhikkhunā imesu pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cattāro dhammā upanissāya vihātabbā.
an9.2:2.3: idha bhikkhu, bhikkhu saṅkhāyekaṃ paṭisevati, saṅkhāyekaṃ adhivāseti, saṅkhāyekaṃ parivajjeti, saṅkhāyekaṃ vinodeti,
an9.2:2.4: evaṃ kho bhikkhu, bhikkhu nissayasampanno hotīti.
